rule: A green validator is evidence only for the obligations it explicitly checks. Do not infer coverage of unlisted semantics or runtime behavior.

checks: Generated README/START_HERE/Current-00/Current-01 are byte-identical to renderer output from Current/CURRENT_STATE.json.
Generated accepted/latest/candidate/controller/next-action summaries are state-driven.
does_not_check: Gameplay correctness
semantic truth of hand-maintained Knowledge/current topic documents

checks: Live-state markers in lifecycle, Knowledge Map, roadmap, live work queue and artifact-evidence human index match CURRENT_STATE accepted/latest/candidate/runtime-pending identity.
Known pre-build/pre-runtime contradictory instructions are forbidden from live authorities while a candidate runtime test is pending.
CURRENT_STATE selected_scope describes the already-built active candidate rather than asking to implement it again.
Active Knowledge Map routes do not retain rejected-candidate machine-state routing.
Artifact evidence contains accepted baseline and active pending candidate identities matching CURRENT_STATE.
A filename-derived duplicate ProfileSources snapshot for the active candidate is forbidden when a canonical build-id snapshot exists.
does_not_check: Gameplay correctness
future contradictory wording not represented by markers/structural checks or the maintained stale-phrase set
GitHub Actions status of a commit

checks: Promotion-safe current-state/controller/lineage consistency
Accepted baseline status/SHA/decision/safe-base agreement with BUILD_LINEAGE
ACTIVE_BUILD and BuildSpecs controller coherence
AUTO_BUILD_RESULT/lineage parent coherence
canonical path existence and Knowledge topic routing/orphans
S1.42AC historical/fresh runtime SHA provenance chain
does_not_check: Actual profile/runtime raw byte SHA values
gameplay correctness
all natural-language semantic contradictions; current live-state semantics are covered by current_state_semantic_validator.py

checks: Canonical handover prompt/cross-links/authority/answerability route exist and preserve fresh-state plus completed-run upload semantics.
does_not_check: Truth of a future handover response before it is produced
GitHub Actions status at a future handover moment

checks: Canonical bounded-segment/checkpoint/continuation/atomicity policy and bootstrap/handover exposure.
does_not_check: Whether every future assistant runtime actually follows the policy

checks: Actual SHA-256 of every indexed profile
readable snapshot/FILE_INDEX existence
completed runtime INDEX/raw-log SHA and size agreement
pending runtime candidates validate profile/snapshot/candidate references without requiring nonexistent runtime evidence
does_not_check: Gameplay semantics
whether a pending candidate should be promoted

checks: Original S1.42AC rejection-era authoritative runtime-log SHA metadata chain and repository-wide qualification of the superseded SHA.
does_not_check: Unregistered future provenance errata

checks: Central known-bad-value registry
registered historical-current documents carry their required local supersession marker and resolve to existing current targets
duplicate same-level current authority claims
orphan Knowledge topics
generated-file protection markers
does_not_check: Arbitrary unknown bad values
unregistered future stale-current prose outside modeled current authorities
gameplay correctness

checks: Canonical Gale replacement helper retains the fail-closed regression/materialization contract.
does_not_check: A user's current local Gale UI/runtime state

checks: Future per-phase checkpoint monotonicity, predecessor PASS, immutability, completion-commit existence and produced-artifact presence.
does_not_check: Retroactive legacy phase ordering

checks: Frozen pre-overhaul contract obligations, backup provenance, completion classifications and promotion-safe current lifecycle coherence.
does_not_check: Gameplay behavior

checks: Semantic routing for maintained answerability cases including accepted build, BCMER, runtime uploader, roadmap and new-chat handover.
does_not_check: Truth of every routed source; live truth is separately covered by current_state_semantic_validator.py

checks: Representative negative fixtures fail: unqualified bad SHA, registered stale-current document without its qualification marker, duplicate authority, orphan topic, phase without predecessor and stale live runtime instruction; registered historical SHA passes.
does_not_check: Formal proof of every validator branch
